title: Glucose discrepancies when using exponential smoothing with G7
body:
ADD TIME OF EVENT HERE: Ongoing


ADD ISSUE DESCRIPTION OR GITHUB ISSUE REFERENCE NUMBER: 

I'm noticing an odd discrepancy on the latest version of AAPS when using exponential smoothing as recommended with the Dexcom G7. The glucose displayed within the AAPS app and on my watch reflect the smoothed value, however the glucose seen in the AAPS persistent notification in the notification tray shows the unaltered Dexcom reading. It's confusing as I cant see the calculated smoothed value without opening the app or checking my watch, which then causes me to worry my numbers are outdated when I see a discrepancy. Is anyone else experiencing this?
